citation: Alem, A.; Ahfir, N.-D.; Elkawafi, A.; Wang, H.Q. Hydraulic Operating Conditions and Particle Concentration Effects on Physical Clogging of a Porous Medium. Transport in Porous Media2015,106(2),303–321. DOI10.1007/s11242-014-0402-8.
parameter_source_locator: Primary author manuscript Section2; Table1; Figures2 and6 captions.
unknowns: water temperature/viscosity for exact intrinsic-permeability conversion

observation_meaning.C_over_C0: Measured effluent concentration normalized by feed, using calibrated turbidity. Selected plotted experimental circles, not an interpolating/model curve.
observation_meaning.K_over_K0: Experimental hydraulic conductivity/permeability ratio inferred by authors from measured pressures and flow via Darcy law. Not a direct independent measurement of intrinsic permeability and not a current-model prediction.
observation_meaning.retained_fraction_of_injected: Post-experiment retained mass normalized by injected mass; numerical source Table1.

digitization.method: Manual experimental marker identification; native pixel centers; affine calibration from labelled linear axes. Filled-circle centroids refined within selected local image components.
digitization.bounds_are_not: experimental error bars, confidence intervals or standard deviations
digitization.startup_omissions: Highly crowded symbols near origin and ambiguous species overlaps excluded; 0.25g/L head concentration markers roughly6–26PV cannot be separated reliably and were not invented.
digitization.high_resolution_attempt: Publisher full and lw1200 routes return same427px-wide raster; zoomed audit images add no information.

limitations: Broad polydisperse kaolinite is not a controlled two-size binary feed.
Original pressure model uses pressure potential; vertical experimental heads require hydraulic-potential treatment.
Two species-specific closures are not identifiable from aggregate concentration and conductivity alone.
Table1 mass recovery is0.9958 and0.9358 in selected flow/head cases; digitization error is much smaller than these experimental mass discrepancies.
Late internal cake is reported for high-concentration runs, not used here.
initial_hydraulic_consistency_note: Using reported Q145mL/min and diameter4.5cm gives U0=.0015195m/s. Reported conductivity K0=.0007m/s times1.05m/.4m gives.0018375m/s if1.05m is total-head difference. Resolve pressure-head versus total-head reference and rounded values; do not silently force incompatible absolute baselines.
hydraulic_domain_interpretation: Figure1 depicts inlet/outlet and intermediate piezometers. Text calls Figure6 overall permeability of the column; full40cm comparison is supported, but exact numerical tap depths/head computation are not specified in schematic. See taps_and_profile_check.md.
